_comment: Site-wide pop-up. mode 'acknowledge' shows it each visit until the visitor clicks 'Don't show this again'; closing with X or Esc only dismisses for that session. Change 'id' for a NEW message so people who acknowledged the last one see the new one. Other modes: 'once' (a single time ever), 'untilDate' (with endDate), 'always'. A message can also run for a set time: "until" (YYYY-MM-DD) ends it and "then" holds the announcement that takes over.
